executive_summary.decision_reason: POLARIS system engineering pipeline cleanly demonstrates closed-loop forecasting -> ForecastBundle -> MILP -> DispatchPlan -> DigitalTwin MPC execution on synthetic scenarios. Engineering demonstration is fully supported and offline, but requires explicit disclosure of material limitations (synthetic inputs, regional proxy wind, data-blocked real demand).

engineering_vs_scientific_validation.engineering_demonstration: Evidence that POLARIS software workflow executes correctly, offline, and deterministically across forecasting -> MILP -> Dispatch -> Simulator.
engineering_vs_scientific_validation.scientific_validation: Evidence establishing real measured station performance, operational fuel savings, or validated deployment performance.
engineering_vs_scientific_validation.distinction_rule: Successful synthetic execution proves engineering system readiness, but MUST NOT be presented as real-world station validation.

prohibited_sih_claims: Real-world polar station fuel savings or monetary cost reductions
Empirical station-level forecasting accuracy on real station microgrids
Real Nuolja wind-generation forecasting or validated turbine power performance
Real station demand forecasting capability (Demand data is DATA BLOCKED)
100% system reliability based on S1 synthetic run (Must state: '0 kWh unmet critical load during the executed 24-step S1 synthetic trajectory')
Equating or averaging execution-run solar MAE (42.3054 W/m2) with frozen Stage 8.1 OOD benchmark MAE (36.188657 W/m2)
Implying S7 fault containment was exercised live during the S1 runtime demonstration
